results.detalle: It stands for the interest rate on 35-day LEBACs until December 31, 2016. Since January 2, 2017, it is the center of the the  on 7-day repo  interest rate corridor. Since August 8, 2018, it is the interest rate on LELIQs. As of January 21, 2020, it is the weighted average rate on the shortest term LELIQ allocated in the latest auction, which remains until the following auction. As of January 6, 2022, it is the monetary policy rate set by the BCRA for 28 days LELIQ, released through a Communication C. From December 18th 2023, corresponds to 1-day BCRA's reverse repo interest rate. Since July 22nd 2024, corresponds to the interest rate announced by the BCRA and accrued by the Liquidity Fiscal Bills (LEFI).  As of July 11, 2025, the BCRA stopped announcing a monetary policy rate.
